terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These terms govern your use of Aestara, including account access, credit purchases, acceptable use, and refunds.

sections.heading: 1. Service Overview
paragraphs: Aestara provides an online AI image generation service. Users can create an account, purchase credits, submit prompts, and generate images through the platform. By accessing or using Aestara, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and Eligibility
items: You must provide accurate account information and keep it up to date.
You are responsible for activity that occurs under your account.
We may suspend or terminate access where use of the service creates legal, security, payment, or abuse risk.

sections.heading: 3. Credits, Pricing, and Billing
paragraphs: Aestara sells one-time credit packages. Credits are consumed when you submit generation requests. Unless otherwise stated on the pricing page, one image generation consumes one credit.

Prices are shown before purchase. Payments are processed by our third-party checkout provider. Depending on the active integration, this may include checkout, payment processing, invoicing, and related billing operations.
Purchased credits do not expire under the current product model. We may change package sizes or prices prospectively at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Refund Policy
paragraphs: You may request a refund within 7 days of purchase by contacting chengshengdeng@gmail.com.

We generally approve refunds for accidental purchases, duplicate purchases, or materially unused credits. Refund decisions may be limited where credits have already been substantially consumed, fraud is suspected, or the request would violate payment processor rules.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable Use
items: You may not use Aestara for unlawful, deceptive, abusive, infringing, or harmful activity.
You may not use the service to generate or distribute non-consensual intimate content, deepfakes, face swaps, or content that impersonates a real person without permission.
You may not submit prompts or create outputs that infringe another party's intellectual property or privacy rights.
We may block prompts, remove content, or suspend accounts to comply with law, payment provider requirements, or platform safety policies.

sections.heading: 6. Generated Content
paragraphs: AI systems can produce inaccurate, unexpected, or similar outputs. You are responsible for reviewing generated images before using, publishing, or selling them.
We do not guarantee that outputs will be unique, error-free, suitable for a specific purpose, or free from third-party claims.

sections.heading: 7. Availability and Changes
paragraphs: We may update, improve, suspend, or discontinue parts of the service at any time. We are not liable for downtime, model changes, or third-party outages that affect availability.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent to chengshengdeng@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains what information Aestara collects, how it is used, and which third parties help operate the service.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Aestara is an AI image generation service that lets users create accounts, purchase credits, submit prompts, and generate images. We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about how we handle your data.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect minimal information to provide and improve our service:
items: Account and Phone Information — When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture. When you sign in or bind with SMS, we process your phone number. Supabase may temporarily hold an unconfirmed number before verification; after verification it is used for authentication and account access.

SMS Delivery Records — To prevent duplicate sends and troubleshoot failures, we retain a server-keyed HMAC phone digest, delivery status, provider request identifiers, and timestamps for no more than 30 days. We do not retain OTP codes, full phone numbers, or raw webhook bodies in these records.

Prompts and Generated Images — We store prompts you submit, generation job data, and generated image results so that the service can deliver outputs, maintain job history, and support refunds or troubleshooting.
Orders and Credit Balances — We store purchase history, credit balances, and order metadata so we can fulfill purchases and maintain account balances.
Theme Preference — We store your light/dark mode preference locally in your browser.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
items: Authenticate your account and provide personalized features
Save and sync your favorites across devices
Process credit purchases, support refunds, and maintain your account balance
Maintain and improve the service

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: We use the following third-party services:
items: Google — For user authentication via Google OAuth.
Supabase — For database, authentication, phone verification, and data storage.
Alibaba Cloud SMS — For delivering one-time sign-in codes to mainland China phone numbers.
Checkout Provider — For payment processing, billing, and related transaction handling.
Vercel — For website hosting and content delivery.
Umami — For privacy-focused website analytics.

sections.heading: Data Storage & Security
paragraphs: Your data is stored securely in Supabase with row-level security (RLS) policies helping ensure that personal account data is only accessible to the appropriate user and service roles. SMS delivery audit records are retained only as long as needed for security and troubleshooting. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Your Rights
items: Access & Delete — You can view or delete your account and all associated data at any time by signing in and using the sign-out feature, then contacting us to permanently delete your data.
Data Portability — You own your data. Contact us if you need an export of your information.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies and local storage for essential functionality such as maintaining your authentication session and theme preference. We may also use privacy-focused analytics tools to understand site performance and product usage at an aggregate level.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, feel free to reach out at chengshengdeng@gmail.com.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.description: This page explains when Aestara credit purchases may be refunded and how to request support.

sections.heading: Eligibility
paragraphs: Refund requests may be submitted within 7 days of the original purchase date.
We generally support refunds for accidental purchases, duplicate charges, or credit packages that remain materially unused.

sections.heading: Limits
items: Credits that have already been substantially consumed may not be refundable.
Refunds may be denied where fraud, abuse, or payment disputes are suspected.
Payment processor requirements, card network rules, and tax obligations may affect whether a refund can be issued.

sections.heading: How to Request a Refund
paragraphs: Email chengshengdeng@gmail.com with your account email, purchase date, and the reason for the request. We will review the request and respond as quickly as practical.
